prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent original hand-placed pixel-art dining-table sprite for a 16-bit top-down farming game. Image 1 is the positive STYLE and CAMERA reference, image 2 shows the game and the grainy mismatched props to improve. Match reference image 1's clean, simple, confident pixel shapes and viewing angle, NOT its exact asset design. This is NOT realistic rendering: NO grain, NO speckles, NO distressed wood, NO fine texture, NO dithering, NO gradients, NO painted/3D look. Think of an actual 64x40 pixel sprite enlarged sharply. A horizontal oval/rounded-rectangle wood tabletop seen from above, its TOP occupies the upper TWO THIRDS of the sprite. Top ellipse is about half as tall as it is wide. Front apron and short stout visible legs occupy the bottom third. Fixed orthographic game camera looking from SOUTH at 45 degrees down: long horizontal edges stay horizontal, object centred, no isometric tilt. Reddish dark-brown wood with just THREE large flat shades (light top, medium front, deep shadow) plus a thin near-plum 1-logical-pixel contour. Three broad planks separated by clean continuous lines, no wood grain marks. Four simple cream plates spaced around the top and one small cream cup in the centre. Plates have simple oval tops and one dark lower rim. The sprite must look clean/readable at 64x40 game pixels, with broad contiguous colour clusters and clear dark recesses. Whole isolated table on transparent background, no ground plane, no shadow, no extra furniture, no text or people.
